projection.note: map x = projected x - x0_km; map y = y1_km - projected y (km, y down)

water.name: Ocean
water.rule: Water deeper than 200 m (Natural Earth bathymetry), away from land.

water.name: Coast
water.rule: Water next to land or shallower than 200 m (the continental shelf).

water.name: Lake
water.rule: Inland water (CORINE water bodies and courses) is most of the hex.

relief.name: Flat
relief.rule: Standard deviation of the 1 km EU-DEM cells inside the hex under 55 m.

relief.name: Mountains
relief.rule: Standard deviation ≥ 150 m, or mean elevation ≥ 850 m (fjell).

relief.name: Peaks
relief.rule: Highest 1 km cell ≥ 1,600 m and standard deviation ≥ 180 m (alpine).

cover.name: Broadleaf forest
cover.rule: Forest is the largest group and broad-leaved (CLC 311) the largest forest type.

cover.name: Conifer forest
cover.rule: Forest is the largest group and coniferous (CLC 312) the largest type: the boreal taiga.

cover.name: Mixed forest
cover.rule: Forest is the largest group and mixed forest (CLC 313) the largest type.

cover.name: Woodland & scrub
cover.rule: Transitional woodland-shrub (CLC 324, often clear-cuts and mountain birch) is the largest group.

cover.name: Grassland
cover.rule: Natural grassland (CLC 321) is the largest group.

cover.name: Farmland
cover.rule: Arable land, permanent crops and agricultural mosaics (CLC 211-244) are the largest group.

cover.name: Mire & wetland
cover.rule: Inland marshes, peat bogs, salt marshes and tidal flats (CLC 411-423) are the largest group.

cover.name: Urban
cover.rule: Artificial surfaces (CLC 111-142) are ≥ 30% of the hex's land, whatever else is there.

cover.name: Bare rock
cover.rule: Bare rock, sparsely vegetated areas, beaches and burnt areas (CLC 331-334) are the largest group.

cover.name: Glacier
cover.rule: Glaciers and perpetual snow (CLC 335) are ≥ 30% of the hex's land.

cover.name: Fjell heath
cover.rule: Moors and heathland (CLC 322) are the largest group: the treeless fjell and coastal heath.

notes.water: From CORINE Land Cover 2018 on the 1 km grid: a hex is land when land classes (CLC 1-39) cover at least 42% of its area (or ≥ 30% with ≥ 4 land neighbours, so narrow sounds and skerry belts read as coast). Sea depth classes come from Natural Earth bathymetry polygons (200/1000/2000/3000 m).
notes.relief: From the EU-DEM 1 km cells inside the hex (≈ 94 cells): mean, standard deviation and maximum.
notes.cover: From CORINE Land Cover 2018 (1 km cells): the largest group of the hex's land cells; urban and glacier win when they reach 30%. Shares in `pct` are whole percent of land cells.
notes.population: Dasymetric: each municipality's official population (1 January) is spread over its hexes in proportion to the GEOSTAT 2018 1 km population grid. Municipal totals are exact; the split inside a municipality is an estimate.
